title: Close the complete first-node source reserve at Consumer.apply
body:
PR2825/2845 left a complete-caller storage obligation: numerical prefixes and individual packet/action envelopes did not yet give a reserve at `Consumer.apply` entry. This package joins the unchanged PR2697 setup, frame validation, all packet tags, generator suspension and output copying into one conditional source-array bound `K0 + G + T + max(six phases)`.

The ledger includes warm numerical high water, all count/serialized/payload categories, the previous cleared directory prefix during replacement, four validation Callback stack cells retained across the packet loop, non-ADD `q²` bucket markers, and cleared count backing until its final reference. PR5108's actual ADD result is reused as an attributed inner component. All 19 caller files match the PR2749 source cohort; the lazy child dependency is explicitly bound as well.

Validation uses the actual width-64, rank-1, depth-2, modulus-3 directory/frame setup with two old prefixes, cold and with 4,500/80 warm slots. Separate complete small packets cover ADD, swap and sign individually and in a four-pass sequence over moduli 3 and 9. Independent integer permutations check every output position, ownership and borrowed restoration. A three-cell validation-stack budget rejects the actual four-cell cut; closed-counter backing remains charged. The actual 64-dimensional payload is not materialized or replaced by the small fixture.

Registered Python 3.12 normal/optimized replay, independent scoped source/proof review, committed-byte/source-history checks, official 48-file export integrity and Git-free optimized cold replay passed. Missing/changed sources and receipt corruption reject. Export SHA256: `73d6dda27bb883f2a6353541aec9e0cbe838f04a134d3e92970405a55868cf39`.

This is a written conditional source-array theorem with finite corroboration. It does not establish Python heap bounds, physical bank/movement costs, exceptional rollback, complete SelectedNode or deeper recursive/outer grants, current selected supplier admission or a new κ. Canonical successful semantics and inherited component lemmas remain explicit premises. The open questions identify those remaining boundaries.

Canonical claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-19143432
